R0033.title: Ghost Stores
R0033.definition: Ghost stores refer to stores that exist on physical or online platforms but are effectively closed, abandoned, or unable to operate normally due to poor management, poor operations, poor sales performance, or other reasons.
R0033.description: On online platforms, especially e-commerce platforms, merchants may sometimes stop operating or go long periods without updating products and services, yet their stores remain active. These abandoned or non-functioning stores are sometimes called 'ghost stores'.
R0033.influence: May lead to the store being unable to provide normal services, declining product quality, and potential inability to process returns or provide after-sales service.

observables: A store has no product updates, transactions, or customer service responses over a long period, yet remains listed on the platform
The store's product inventory stays at zero or delisted for a long time, with after-sales metrics deteriorating continuously
The store's qualifications mismatch its actual operating category, or it has been repeatedly complained about for being unable to provide service

R0033-001.title: Merchant Disappearance / Runaway
R0033-001.definition: A merchant suddenly becomes unreachable after operating on the platform for a period of time.
R0033-001.description: Some disappearances may be caused by sudden circumstances or poor management, while others are deliberate — either to evade platform responsibilities and after-sales obligations, or to cold-shoulder buyer complaints. Merchants typically stop shipping and customer service after collecting sufficient payments or advances, and may even transfer security deposits and account funds, leaving buyers with neither goods nor money and triggering concentrated complaints and advance-payment and reputational losses for the platform.
R0033-001.influence: May lead to the store being unable to provide normal services, inability to process returns, or lack of after-sales service.

references.title: SAMR Advances 2024 Online Market Supervision Special Action

observables: A merchant suddenly stops responding after operating for a period, with customer service messages left unread for a long time
The store's security deposit is withdrawn or transferred, with abnormal outflow of account funds
Buyer refund and after-sales requests surge in a concentrated burst, with the merchant unresponsive and shipping halted
